projects.title: Tickfolio
projects.description: A paper-inspired Android checklist app with photo attachments, scheduled reminders, and location alerts.

projects.title: Inconscio
projects.description: Companion app for a tabletop RPG that's being design by a friend of mine. This can be considered my first freelance paid work, and it's yet another fully multiplatform app. I'll work on some customly designed layouts too, so a lot of Canvases to be tested on both platforms.

projects.title: Where?
projects.description: A geoguessr-like game where you are presented with a small patch of the Earth and you have to guess where are you, by stating the city or the nation, and receving points. Very small app built in few hours during a workshop with high-school students in Garmin. Currently not published.

projects.title: Home Notes
projects.description: Another fully multiplatform mobile app, this time with a small self-hosted server. The goal is to self-host and share ideas and small notes that I take during the day. It's a yet another experiment built with KMM, Compose Multiplatform and few other libraries. Not public yet!
metadata: Personal project, Android, iOS, on hold

projects.title: Inconsistencies Detector
projects.description: A project for the Human Language Technologies course, consisting of a small model that detects iconsistencies in natural language paragraphs.
metadata: University project, machine learning, on hold

projects.title: Eye4Eye
projects.description: A small playground for the Prisoner's Dilemma. I plan on making a modular environment where to deploy a Reinforcement Learning actor and see what happens.

projects.title: L'Urlo della Colomba
projects.description: An RPG made with RPG Maker MZ. Coming soon (-ish, it's a spare time project so I don't know how often and how much I will work on this)

projects.title: ndoTap
projects.description: My first web app, built with NuxtJS. Born as a UI validation tool, it presents the user with a screenshot and a simple task, asking the question "where would you tap?". By gathering these data as an heatmap, the developer can decide wether or not the GUI is well thought out.
metadata: Personal project, web app, on hold

projects.title: NuzlockOne
projects.description: A fully multiplatform App built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, Ktor and more.A companion for those brave gamers that undertake the final Pokémon challenge: a Nuzlocke!There are few elements I am not satisfied with, that I want to work on before releasing it.
metadata: Personal project, Android, iOS, on hold

projects.title: Cosplay Means Be Whatever You Want
projects.description: A tribute to My Dress-Up Darling and the cosplay world as a whole, realised together with Ciocoreto: a 10 hours long shooting session in studio to make a collage of all Marin Kitagawa's cosplays in a single image!

projects.title: Statues, part one
projects.description: My very first "big" photography project. Inspired by classical sculptures, the idea is to capture those atmospheres and vibes into photography, with delicate poses of anonymous subjects lightly covered by white cloth.

projects.title: Parallel Huffman
projects.description: A project for the Parallel Systems course, where I implemented a parallel version of the Huffman Coding algorithm.

projects.title: Wear Countdown
projects.description: A proof-of-concept of a countdown app for Wear OS, built using Jetpack Compose and its navigation system, along with the Horologist library. It provides support to Tiles and Complications!

projects.title: Artificial Creativity
projects.description: As a project for the ISPR course, I've written a small review of current common prompt-based and prompt-free image, text and music generation systems. While writing this review I learned a lot about the inner workings of Stable Diffusion, DALL-E and StyleGAN, all three being really fascinating.
metadata: University project, publication, review, machine learning, finished

projects.title: Be My Boulder
projects.description: Made in collaboration with Giuseppe Gatto and Duccio Breschi, it's a cloud-based ranking systems for bouldering routes, used to keep track of the routes and of the users' scores. It includes a web app for the users, backend and a mobile app for the admins to add and manage the routes and the routes' photos. I've worked on the mobile apps, which are currently not publicly available.

projects.title: The HHL Algorithm
projects.description: A few-pages long report on the HHL algorithm, a quantum approach to solving linear systems of equations and a very interesting dive into the perks of quantum computing.
metadata: University project, publication, review, quantum computing, finished

projects.title: Exoplanet Explorer
